messages:
Maya R.: Hey folks — first day! Laptop is here but my monitor/dock shipment shows delivered to 'Front Desk' in tracking but not at my desk. Also can't join 'Redwood-Staff' Wi-Fi, getting '802.1X: authentication failed'. I put in ticket #6129 but tagging IT here in case. Desk: 4F-11. Thanks!

IT Helpdesk Bot: Thanks @Maya R.! Ticket #6129 created and assigned to Liam (IT). ETA for initial response: 30m. If urgent, mention @Liam (IT). :robot_face:

Liam (IT): Hey Maya — welcome! Can you paste the tracking number you see? I'll check with facilities. For Wi‑Fi, try guest network while we dig in: SSID 'Redwood-Guest' — use the onboarding email link to get the temporary passcode. If you're on mac/windows tell me which OS.

Maya R.: Tracking shows ZX123456789US and says 'Delivered to Front Desk' at 09:12. I'm on macOS 13.5.1.

George - Facilities: Hi @Liam @Maya R. — package ZX123456789US is logged at Mailroom Shelf B, under 'New Hires'. I can drop it to 4F in ~20m or you can pickup. :package: 

Sophia T.: If you want to avoid the dock, I have a spare USB‑C hub you're welcome to borrow. Can leave at Maya's desk. :smile:

Liam (IT): OK Maya, try connecting to Redwood-Guest for now. If mac Wi‑Fi still fails, from Terminal run:

```
networksetup -setairportpower en0 off
sleep 2
networksetup -setairportpower en0 on
```

Then try joining. If you see an '802.1X' prompt, select 'Use System' credentials and enter your SSO email + the temporary guest token from onboarding email. If you can't find token, I'll DM you.

Maya R.: Ran the commands, still get the 802.1X popup that won't accept my corp password. I don't see a guest token in my onboarding email. Could you DM it?

Liam (IT): DMing the guest token now. Also trying to push a quick certificate fix — one sec.

IT Helpdesk Bot: Liam added note: escalated to Network team (ticket NW-277).

Liam (IT): Network pushed a cert refresh to your account. Try reconnecting now.

Maya R.: Connected! :tada: Also George just dropped the monitor/dock — thanks all. Do I need to register the dock or anything?

Liam (IT): Awesome. No registration needed. Dock is plug-and-play. If the external monitor doesn't wake, try toggling `Detect Displays` in System Settings -> Displays, or run:

```
sudo killall -HUP WindowServer
```

If at all stuck open a quick support call and I can remote in.

Sophia T.: Welcome again @Maya R.! See you at the 4F stand-up.

Maya R.: Thanks everyone, saved the day :heart:
